def runs(cells):
    out=[]; i=0
    while i<len(cells):
        if cells[i]!=0:
            c=cells[i]; j=i
            while j<len(cells) and cells[j]==c: j+=1
            out.append((i,j-1,c)); i=j
        else: i+=1
    return out

    claimed={}

        claimed[(rr,ccol)]=col; return True

steps.input:
# Print full non-bg views of each demo pair side by side to infer the rule.
def show(i,o,n):
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in i for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    print('=== demo',n,'bg',bg)
    h,w=len(i),len(i[0])
    for r in range(h):
        ai=''.join('.' if x==bg else str(x) for x in i[r])
        ao=''.join('.' if x==bg else str(x) for x in o[r])
        tag=' <== DIFF' if ai!=ao else ''
        print('%2d %s | %s %s'%(r,ai,ao,tag))
for n in [4]:
    show(P[f'Demo pair {n} input'],P[f'Demo pair {n} output'],n)

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    changed=True
    while changed:
        changed=False
        for i in range(H):
            j=0
            while j<W:
                if g[i][j]==0: j+=1; continue
                k=j
                while k+1<W and g[i][k+1]==g[i][j]: k+=1
                # extend past any bg gap
                while k+1<W and (g[i][k+1]==0 or g[i][k+1]==g[i][j]): k+=1
                start=j; end=k
                seg=g[i][start]
                gaps=[x for x in range(start,end+1) if g[i][x]==0]
                if len(gaps)==1:
                    c=g[i][start]
                    for x in range(start,end+1): g[i][x]=c
                    gap=gaps[0]
                    for y in range(i-1,-1,-1):
                        if g[y][gap]!=0: break
                        g[y][gap]=c
                    y=i+1
                    while y<H and g[y][gap]==0:
                        g[y][gap]=c; y+=1
                    changed=True
                j=k
    return g
